entities.name: 1963 Ankara mid-air collision
entities.label: Place
entities.summary: A mid-air collision occurred on Friday, 1 February 1963, over Ankara, Turkey, when Middle East Airlines Flight 265, a Vickers 754D Viscount completing a flight from Cyprus, came in for landing and collided in the air with a Turkish Air Force Douglas C-47A. After the collision both planes fell directly onto the city below them. All 17 people on board both aircraft died, along with 87 people on the ground.
